sources.citation: Barbosa Aguiar et al. (2011), Zonal structure of the mean flow and eddies in the Azores Current system
sources.source_summary: The drifter study covers December 1990-June 2008, with drogues centered at 15 m. Its surface mean does not resolve a persistent zonally continuous northern AzCC. Distinct westward flows include a plateau-associated recirculation. The authors explicitly leave deeper counterflow possible.
sources.use: Surface continuity is not established; absence at the surface does not establish absence at depth.

sources.citation: Comas-Rodriguez et al. (2011), The Azores Current System from a meridional section at 24.5 W
sources.source_summary: Stations were occupied 26 October-1 November 2009. At 24.5 W, stations 42-46 bound the subsurface westward AzCC between 36.25 and 35.25 N. The reported approximately 110 km is transverse width. Upper-50-m and nearly-700-m SADCP averages are distinct diagnostics. The shallow signal does not reproduce the AzCC. Figure 1's caption says fall 2010, conflicting with the methods' 2009 dates.
sources.use: Retain existing scoped width without duplication. Keep date discrepancy explicit; the methods end date supports the existing November date. Do not convert the transverse span into current length.

next_action: Seek explicit subsurface alongflow endpoints and continuity in the original Onken (1993) or Alves et al. (2002) study; do not reconstruct a whole-current route from the surface study or concatenate transverse surveys.
